title: Sharing sprites made with mix of ai and manual drawing
author: Scary-Huckleberry664
selftext:
Hi there,

  
I do use a mix of ai and manual editing and drawing to create consistent characters for visual novels.

  
I'd like to publish some VN kits including Sprites and also small "template" projects for renpy (and maybe later for other engines): for example a romance template, a detective template etc.

A lot of aspiring gamedev are stuck because of lack of sprites or a way to begin so it is more aimed to beginners but not only.

Could I publish them on this sub? My goal is to have some feedback and maybe later build a patreon etc for custom content.

  
Is it allowed on this sub and is this a good/bad idea?
